document.title: 222Emails Master Operating Context
document.naming_rule: Use 222Emails with no space. No underscores in new canonical context filenames.

positioning.primary_operating_wedge: Appointment-led Revenue Recovery / Client Return Systems
positioning.primary_proving_ground: Lancashire salons and barbers, then suitable UK appointment-led SMEs
positioning.existing_adjacent_capability: Ecommerce Revenue Recovery / lifecycle revenue recovery
positioning.master_line: 222Emails finds where businesses are losing revenue from leads, customers and follow-up, then builds the systems to recover it.
positioning.canonical_sales_line: We found where revenue is leaking. Here is what it is worth. Here is the system to recover it. Here is what we charge.

increase_us_toward_40_pct_when: materially higher willingness to pay than current UK ladder
consider_50_50_when: acceptable gross margin and founder load
consider_us_primary_when: ACV consistently several times the UK wedge
expected profit per founder acquisition hour materially exceeds UK alternative
market_strategy.pivot_rule: Do not switch because the US is larger. Switch only when economics and execution evidence are clearly superior.
market_strategy.principle: Use the business already built as the launchpad, not the ceiling.

us_pricing.rule: Do not port UK prices automatically and do not treat US pricing as canonical until paid validation exists.

goals.twelve_month_direction: Push toward multi-million-pound business economics without treating that ambition as a guaranteed forecast.
goals.north_star_question: How much recoverable revenue can 222Emails identify, recover and prove?
